specialAttack.name: Rage
specialAttack.description: +4 morale bonus to Str and Con, +2 morale bonus on Will saves, -2 to AC (+6/+3 at 11th level, +8/+4 at 20th), and -2 to Int; rounds per day 4 + Con modifier, +2 a level after 1st

One Flesh.descriptionOnly: no path: the consumed creature's ability taken on is a polymorph effect of its own

Unbound Rage.descriptionOnly: no path: enlarge person, +4 size bonus to Str and -2 Int while raging, is a condition of its own

Unbound Form.descriptionOnly: no path: the consumed creature's shape is a polymorph effect of its own
